# Base

This project was generated using [Angular CLI](https://github.com/angular/angular-cli) version 22.2.6.

## Development server

To start a local development server, run:

```bash
ng serve
```

Once the server is running, open your browser and navigate to `http://localhost:4200/`. The application will automatically reload whenever you modify any of the source files.

## Code scaffolding

Angular CLI includes powerful code scaffolding tools. To generate a new component, run:

```bash
ng generate component component-name
```

For a complete list of available schematics (such as `components`, `directives`, or `pipes`), run:

```bash
ng generate --help
```

## Building

To build the project run:

```bash
ng build
```

This will compile your project and store the build artifacts in the `dist/` directory. By default, the production build optimizes your application for performance and speed.

## Running unit tests

To execute unit tests with the [Vitest](https://vitest.dev/) test runner, use the following command:

```bash
ng test
```

## Running end-to-end tests

For end-to-end (e2e) testing, run:

```bash
ng e2e
```

Angular CLI does not come with an end-to-end testing framework by default. You can choose one that suits your needs.

## Additional Resources

For more information on using the Angular CLI, including detailed command references, visit the [Angular CLI Overview and Command Reference](https://angular.dev/tools/cli) page.

 "summary": "Landing page, direction C ('Two languages, one system'), built on @hawiyah/angular, styles and tokens 0.2.1 (plus @hawiyah/core 0.2.1 for date formatting). The first screen states what Hawiyah is in Arabic and English at equal weight on either side of a divider, with the npm install line and a copy button beneath, followed by the same composition (tabs, text field, Umm al-Qura/Gregorian date picker, primary button, summary list) rendered in two containers that each carry their own lang, dir, colour mode and density. Five segmented controls between the panes change one pane at a time, so a combination such as English with right-to-left, dark and compact can be tried next to an untouched pane. Below are install steps for Angular, React, Vue and JavaScript in tabs, the seven packages as one description list, and the compliance statement with links; the header has working language, direction and colour-mode controls and the footer carries the licence and the independence statement. Capture report: 8 variants with zero horizontal overflow, zero animations under reduced motion, zero axe violations and zero console errors; the 17 small targets are all package rendering (listed under knownIssues).",
 "idea": "The page is organised around a spine. Arabic and English are set at the same size on either side of it: the page language supplies the h1 and comes first, the other language sits beside it in its own lang and dir, so neither reads as a translation tucked under the other. The same spine continues into the live comparison: two panes render one small appointment form with real package components, each inside its own container, and the captions print the exact attributes in force (lang, dir, data-hw-mode, data-hw-density). The controls in the middle change one pane only, which makes the claim that language, direction, colour mode and density are independent something the reader can verify in a few seconds rather than a sentence to take on trust. Arabic starts with the Umm al-Qura calendar and English with the Gregorian one, and each shows the other calendar's date as the field hint, so the date picker's two calendars are visible at rest. Everything below (install, packages, compliance) is plain and short, with npm first.",
 "motion": [
  "Pane settle on load: each pane's stage fades from opacity 0 and slides one --hw-space-3 along its own inline axis (from its inline-start edge, so the Arabic pane and the English pane move towards each other). --hw-duration-slow (280ms), --hw-ease-standard; the second pane starts after --hw-duration-fast (120ms). Runs once. Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce the rule is not applied at all (it is declared only inside prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference), so the panes are simply present.",
  "Pane transition on a control change: only the affected pane replays a short cross-fade (opacity 0.25 to 1) with the same --hw-space-3 inline slide, --hw-duration-slow and --hw-ease-standard; the new attributes apply immediately, the controls and the other pane do not move, and nothing moves under the pointer. Under reduced motion no animation runs and the new state is shown at once.",
  "No other motion of my own. Component motion (switch thumb, tab indicator, dialog) is the packages' own and already honours reduced motion; there are no loops."
 ],

  "HwPortalHeaderComponent",
  "HwPortalFooterComponent",
  "HwSwitchComponent",
  "HwButtonDirective",
  "HwContainerComponent",
  "HwDividerComponent",
  "HwToggleGroupComponent",
  "HwTabsComponent",
  "HwTabComponent",
  "HwTextFieldComponent",
  "HwDatePickerComponent (with its HwDialogComponent and HwCalendarComponent)",
  "HwDescriptionListComponent",
  "HwCardComponent",
  "HwLinkComponent",
  "HwAlertComponent (placeholder route only)",
  "formatCalendarDate from @hawiyah/core"
 ],
 "ownCssLines": 78,
 "packageGaps": [
  "No code-block component: code samples are plain <pre><code> with token-only styling and an hwButton for copy.",
  "No typography for headings and running text outside components (no heading, lead or prose utilities). hw-page-header renders one h1 only, so two statements of equal weight needed own token-based type classes (.t-h1, .t-h2, .t-h3, .t-body, .t-muted).",
  "hw-portal-header renders its skip link as a bare '#id' href. Under <base href=\"/\">, which Angular applications normally have, that link navigates to the site root instead of the current page. Worked around by providing APP_BASE_HREF and removing the <base> element.",
  "hw-date-picker shows one calendar system at a time. Showing the Umm al-Qura and Gregorian dates together needs formatCalendarDate, which @hawiyah/angular does not re-export; @hawiyah/core 0.2.1 was added as a direct dependency for it.",
  "hw-date-picker puts the formatted date into the input without direction isolation: in a lang=en dir=rtl container '10 Nov 2026' displays as 'Nov 2026 10'. String inputs such as hint and description-list values have the same problem; mine are wrapped in Unicode isolates.",
  "hw-tabs offers no way to move focus to the active tab after the value is changed from inside a panel (the Continue button); the page queries [role=tab][aria-selected=true] itself. hw-tab labels are plain text, so framework logos could not be shown in the install tabs.",
  "hw-description-list items are strings only: package names cannot be marked up as code or as left-to-right, and cannot be links.",
  "No compact control for header preferences: buttons have no pressed-state styling for aria-pressed, hw-toggle-group always shows its legend, and there are no language, direction or colour-mode icons. The header uses one hwButton and two hw-switch controls, which wrap onto two extra rows on a phone. The header's actions area does not shrink (flex-shrink: 0), so the group needed its own max-inline-size to wrap.",
  "Layout primitives (hw-stack, hw-grid and so on) render an inline host element around the styled div, so they cannot be placed as grid or flex items without a wrapper; page layout uses own grid CSS and hw-container.",
  "Target sizes: links in hw-portal-footer are 20px tall, and the skip link and the radios inside hw-toggle-group measure 1x1 because they are visually hidden (their labels are 36px tall). These pass WCAG 2.5.8 through the spacing and equivalent-control exceptions but show up in automated counts."
 ],

Reference copies are in .shared-original and .shared-snapshot inside this workspace.",
  "This workspace's node_modules contains unused codemirror packages: the shared package.json already listed them (from the editor workspace) when @hawiyah/core was installed. This workspace's package.json no longer lists them; package-lock.json still has their package entries.",
  "Components and Templates links lead to a placeholder route that says they are outside this prototype.",
  "Small targets reported by the capture script (17 per variant): the skip link, ten visually hidden radios inside toggle groups and six footer links, all package rendering (see packageGaps).",
